notes: #1 is the same 1767 view in a Russian–French edition, photographed across a book gutter; #3 is the clean plate. Lespinasse’s plate records the view at the time of Catherine II’s 1767 visit; the engraving may have been printed somewhat later. #7: Moynet’s Volga travel account was published in Le Tour du monde vol. 15 (1867). #2, #4, #5 and #16 show Kazan Cathedrals in St. Petersburg and Moscow, and #8 is the Kazan hill in Smolensk: all other cities.
